title: Circular Shoulder Rubbing
summary: Small controlled circular movements are applied to the soft tissues over the upper shoulders and upper trapezius.
goal: Gradually increase local warmth and prepare the soft tissues for more pronounced kneading.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of circular rubbing over the upper shoulder region.
startingPosition: The shoulders are fully relaxed. The finger pads or heel of the hand rest on the soft tissues over the upper shoulder.
instructions: Place the hand on the soft part of the shoulder rather than a bony prominence.
Make small circular movements that move the tissue rather than sliding over the skin.
Progress slowly along the upper shoulder.
direction: Small circles over the upper shoulder soft tissues, gradually progressing along the muscle.
tips: The circle should move the soft tissue rather than rub the skin.
mistakes: Pressing onto the acromion or other bony prominences.
Using circles that are too large or too fast.
warning: Reduce pressure or stop if the area becomes painful. Do not rub inflamed or damaged skin.
telegramCaption: Controlled circular movements over the soft tissues of the upper shoulders.
